subject: general
question:
Identify the error in the following sentence.

The police are searching about the missing jewellery.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the preposition "**about**" instead of "**for**".
 
• The verb "**searching**" is typically followed by the preposition "**for**" when indicating what is being searched.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**searching for the missing jewellery**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The police are searching for the missing jewellery."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **the** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **missing** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **are** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 1.
